nodes.question: What is projected to happen to greenhouse gas emissions from solid waste treatment and disposal by 2050 if no corrective actions are taken?
nodes.answer: Greenhouse gas emissions are projected to increase from 1.6 billion tons in 2016 to 2.6 billion tons by 2050.
